title.rendered: Nitty Gritty Dirt Band: From Small Things (Big Things One Day Come)

content.rendered:
The Nitty Gritty Dirt Band has a knack for spotting Springsteen songs that are ripe for a rockabilly cover treatment.

They scored with their 1984 cover of “Cadillac Ranch,” and six years later they rescued “From Small Things” from obscurity and landed it on the Billboard Country Top 100 chart, where it peaked at #65.

Their version breathes a bit more than Bruce’s original but retains its rebellious outlaw spirit. Here’s the studio recording and a live TV performance.

© September 16, 2018

excerpt.rendered: “From Small Things” got some cover love long before Bruce officially released it. Here’s one of the best. from the Nitty Gritty Dirt Band in 1990.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Nitty Gritty Dirt Band: Cadillac Ranch
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Two great live performances of "Cadillac Ranch" today--both by the Nitty Gritty Dirt Band.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Rod Melancon: 57 Channels (And Nothin’ On)
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Southern rocker Rod Melancon perfectly translates "57 Channels" to the stage without losing the original's dystopian, alienated spirit.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Ghost Hounds and Sasha Allen: Thunder Road
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Pittsburgh rockers The Ghost Hounds team up with Sasha Allen on a terrific cover of one of Bruce's greatest hits.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Daniele Tenca: Johnny 99
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Daniele Tenca turned in a gloriously gritty cover of "Johnny 99" at a live performance in 2018. It's now my all-time favorite arrangement of the song.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Amy Helm: Atlantic City
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Band may have recorded the definitive cover of "Atlantic City," but Amy Helm does her dad proud with her own version.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Around and Around
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Many, many times--but almost always in small clubs: Bruce rocks the house with a cover of Chuck Berry's classic B-side, "Around and Around."
